title: Actress-politician faces license suspension from LTO after dancing while driving

blocks.text: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) has issued a show cause order (SCO) against an actress-politician from Taytay, Rizal over alleged distracted driving after a video showed her dancing while behind the wheel. In a statement on Saturday, Nov. 14, the LTO said the video, which was uploaded on the Taytay councilor’s Facebook page, showed her recording herself while driving, removing both hands from the steering wheel to dance as the vehicle was moving.
